records.full_test_name: Mix and Mega > should overwrite forme-change abilities on Mega Evolution
records.evidence: The test constructs gen9mixandmega and exercises Mega Evolution, neither of which exists in the resolved Gen 3 OU RuleTable.

records.full_test_name: Partners in Crime > should activate shared abilities at the same time as other abilities
records.evidence: The test constructs gen9partnersincrime doubles and depends on shared innate abilities; Gen 3 OU is singles and has no Partners in Crime rule.

records.full_test_name: Partners in Crime > should activate shared abilities for each ally when only the original holder switches in
records.evidence: The assertion requires gen9partnersincrime doubles, allied active slots, and shared innate abilities, all absent from Gen 3 OU singles.

records.full_test_name: Partners in Crime > should not activate ally's innates if the partner faints on switch-in
records.evidence: The assertion requires gen9partnersincrime doubles and partner-faint innate suppression; Gen 3 OU has one active per side and no innate-sharing rule.
This is a meta-test for Showdown's JavaScript ExhaustiveRunner across its own format list, not a battle-semantic assertion for Gen 3 OU.
